record.question: ‘Golden Revolution’ is related to -
record.explanation: Answer D: Horticulture and Honey. Golden Revolution refers to horticulture and related production, particularly fruits and honey. Reference: https://agricoop.gov.in/en/GoldenRevolution. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: Group B (NG) Technical Paper-II General Knowledge, November 2024 examination..
